flightModel.sampleAt: midpoint of each of the three native flight holds
flightModel.trajectory: height = 4 * apex * u * (1-u), u = time / airtime

limitations: Only five held poses; this is not continuous ballistic playback or a native FPS improvement.
Grounded legs accommodate less than one output pixel; no newly painted knee or arm articulation.
Native action repeats three times; landing has one held pose, not a within-slot recovery animation.
Naturalness and restrained character remain subject to actual-size visual review.
